additional_info.subject: RE: ID0464162-DC/Si-D/FR-[Multi] No OCPP communication CRM:03056000610
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Desmoutier,
Today I had time to check again the chargers and troubleshoot the routers.
For charger
MP / S2 170003310
, I connected remotely, reset the router to default settings, forced Wired connection and it went online in the OCPP Backend.
Charger
MP / S2 170003306
cannot connect to the Backend instead, because it cannot connect to internet. I also connected remotely, I reset the router to default settings, forced Wired connection, used Wired connection even as Failover, but the router is not going online from OCPP Backend side.
On this charger, unfortunately I suspect one of the following issues:
The ETH cable to the router is defective, hence there is no connection to internet.
The Router and ETH cable are fine, and there is a problem in the external router from your side to provide internet connection.
Our router has an internal issue and needs to be replaced.
I believe that the best way to proceed is for the siemens colleagues from RC-FR to coordinate with you an onsite troubleshooting activity, and in case replace the router. For the remote troubleshooting session, I would recommend to coordinate it with the Siemens colleague from RC-FR as well, as unfortunately I am fully booked for tomorrow and Thursday. If you could verify point number 2 from your side, so that your router is connected to internet, we could already exclude one point.
For the next steps, please refer to the RC-FR colleagues in copy in this email.
Thank you for your patience and support!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
